You have three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. No move cleared its cost this week, so you are holding your free transfer. Pope on the bench projects 2.3; Mykolenko, the best of your bench, sits at 3.1.

Your team projects 69.0 this week with Haaland captained. He's a fraction clear of Salah as captain — only 0.3 expected points separate them — but the model prefers the armband where it sits.

You're holding your transfer. No move returned more than its cost, which leaves you flexibility for next week when you'll have two moves to play with alongside your current bank of £0.5m.

Three Arsenal players in your eleven means you're concentrated in one direction, though that's balanced against having two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. Mykolenko on the bench projects 3.1, which makes him worth watching if he's set for minutes, but nothing in your squad screams for immediate change.

Your bench totals 10.7, well back of the eleven. That's the price of having your best players in the side, and it's consistent with the starting lineup being strong enough to hold.
